newsitem.title: USA: Consumers Mich. nuke to shut for six days.
newsitem.headline: Consumers Mich. nuke to shut for six days.

text.p: Consumers Power Co's 67 megawatt (MW) Big Rock Point nuclear unit 1 in Charlevoix, Mich., will be shut down for approximately six days to repair a valve leak, the company said Tuesday.
"We're in the process of shutting down to repair a packing leak on a reactor depressurization isolation valve," said company spokesman Tim Petrosky.
Consumers' other nuclear plant, the 780 MW Palisades 1 in South Haven, Mich., is operating at full power.
Consumers is a subsidiary of CMS Energy Corp.
